page.notes: Left margin: a column of small printed "»" marks, one beside most lines (quotation or section marks); not transcribed as text. The first word "pud" is a fragment of "apud" carried over from the previous page. Italic run: the printer set the whole passage from "Et ubi" to "ad a-" in italic. Possible printing irregularities: "aternam" appears without the ligature; "præcipuè" and "discretionis" are read from a faint scan. The line "gnitionem" at lower right is the catchword, not part of the text.
